question: According to Figure 4D-2, what are the general minimum and maximum longitudinal distances from the stop line for the primary signal faces, absent the near-side supplemental-face exception?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Per Figure 4D-2 and Section 4D.08, the primary signal faces must be located no less than 40 feet beyond the stop line and no more than 180 feet beyond the stop line (for 12-inch signal indications), unless a supplemental near-side signal face is provided. The figure additionally shows a 120-foot maximum from the stop line for 8-inch signal faces. Standards (mandatory): - "A signal face installed to satisfy the requirements for primary left-turn signal faces (see Sections 4F.02 through 4F.08) and primary right-turn signal faces (see Sections 4F.09 through 4F.15), and at least one and preferably both of the minimum of two primary signal faces required for the through movement (or the major turning movement if there is no through movement) on the approach shall be located: 1. No less than 40 feet beyond the stop line, and 2. No more than 180 feet beyond the stop line unless a supplemental near-side signal face is provided." - "The primary signal faces that are used to satisfy the requirements of Item A shall simultaneously satisfy the lateral placement requirement described in Section 4D.07 (see Figure 4D-2)." Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 4D-2 shows the 40 ft* dimension as the "Minimum distance of signal faces from stop line," 120 ft** as the "Maximum distance from stop line for 8-inch signal face," and 180 ft*** as the "Maximum distance from stop line for 12-inch signal faces, unless a near-side supplemental signal face is used," measured within the 20-degree lateral cones from a point 10 feet behind the stop line. [Image 2] Page 713 reproduces Figure 4D-2 with the same 40 ft minimum and 120 ft/180 ft maximum dimensions. [Image 3] Page 714 contains Section 4D.08, stating the 40-foot minimum and 180-foot maximum longitudinal placement standard. [Image 4] Page 712 contains Section 4D.07's lateral positioning standard that the same signal face must simultaneously satisfy. Citations: - Figure 4D-2 (p.672) - Section 4D.08 Standard §1 (p.673) - Section 4D.07 Standard §1 (p.671) - Page 713 - Page 714 - Page 712
gold_answer: At least 40 feet and no more than 180 feet beyond the stop line.
